title: Sharp Risk for Stationary POMDP Policy Value under Weak Mixing and Unknown Emissions

gap_reasons: The delivered result is a matched three-regime minimax rate, with a total estimator and an original-record converse on the same reset class, rather than an exact risk constant. Its substantive limitation is the three-parameter architecture: perfectly erasing fair resets, ancillary observed states, symmetric emissions, and conditional reward-transition independence do the work that remains unresolved for general unknown joint kernels. Strict inclusion transfers only the lower bound and consistency necessity; the framing respects this distinction and contains no stale ambient-frontier claim. The episodic revealing assumptions in [Zhang and Jiang (2025)](https://proceedings.iclr.cc/paper_files/paper/2025/file/64ae05e3f1a88ebac7f9263b69f4e702-Paper-Conference.pdf) support the stated non-subsumption, while the non-archival internal parent supplies no independently checked priority evidence. The specifically identified classical Tsybakov testing theorem should receive source verification because its theorem text was inaccessible, rather than be treated as an unproved novel kernel. The projected score is constrained by the narrow structural scope and the absence of delivered stress-benchmark computations supporting the proposed adoption path; the proved surface establishes a field contribution but neither resolves the ambient problem nor delivers a broadly applicable framework. proof_attempt_summary: The whole-class weak-contraction frontier did not close its lower/upper gap; the launch-authorized pivot delivered a matched unknown-emission/dynamics reset-family rate min{1,(T delta^4)^-1,(sqrt(T) delta)^-1}, a total four-moment estimator, and an original-record converse. The missing reset-class dependency edge was repaired and graph validation passed without stale proofs; no Lean formalization was attempted.
tldr: The unknown-emission, unknown-dynamics reset experiment has the proved sharp stationary causal-value squared-risk surface \(r(T,\delta)=\min\{1,(T\delta^4)^{-1},(\sqrt T\,\delta)^{-1}\}\). Four bounded observable scores and one total finite-grid estimator attain it, including complete signal collapse. The matching original observed-word converse holds for arbitrary word lengths, with stationary initialization and geometric run sums controlled uniformly. Reset uniform consistency holds exactly when \(T\delta_T^2\to\infty\). Strict inclusion transfers the lower bound and this necessary condition to the full ambient unknown-joint-kernel class. The reset estimator, upper bound, sufficiency, and exact consistency boundary are not transferred. The sharp ambient frontier remains unresolved. At fixed gap the reset risk has \(T^{-1}\) order.
gap: Hu and Wager (2023) establish stationary POMDP OPE rates over a broader hidden-state class. Zhang and Jiang (2025) give the distinct policy-memory regimes displayed in the comparison table. Abraham, Gassiat, and Naulet (2023) study latent parameter learning near singularity. These results do not evaluate the unknown-emission and unknown-dynamics reset stationary-value surface uniformly in the public contraction gap.
